subject: Private deployment expansion & renewal — Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Tara Nguyen <tara@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment expansion & renewal questions

Hi Marissa —

Hope you’re well. Our renewal for the current Dedicated seats is coming up on May 1, and leadership would like to evaluate expanding our private footprint to support additional isolation and on-prem clusters. High-level asks from our side:

- Add two on-prem clusters (one EU, one US) for workload isolation and data sovereignty.
- HSM integration for key management and FIPS support.
- Updated SLA (we’ll need 99.9% or equivalent for the private clusters).
- Clarification on migration windows and impact to the existing Dedicated pool.

Could you send a short proposal with cost delta and timeline? Also attaching our current contract for reference (acme_current_contract.pdf).

Thanks — happy to set up a quick call next week.

—Tara
Tara Nguyen
Director, AI Infrastructure
Acme Analytics

Attachment: acme_current_contract.pdf (PDF, 512 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tara Nguyen <tara@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment expansion & renewal questions

Tara —

Thanks for the summary and the contract PDF. High level, we can support both options — Dedicated VPC expansion or an on-prem / air-gapped deployment with our Private package. The major decision points that will drive cost and timeline are:

- Number and sizing of clusters (GPU type, node count)
- Network topology (VPN vs direct connect vs air-gapped transfer)
- HSM/KMS integration and customer-managed keys
- Regulatory evidence (SOC 2 artefacts, any extra attestations)

Quick proposal from our side:
- Pilot: one EU on-prem cluster for validation (4x A100 equivalent nodes) — 2–3 weeks to stand up after kickoff.
- Production expansion: add a US on-prem cluster + HA replicas; target roll by Aug 1, 2026.
- Pricing: rough uplift ~+40% on top of current committed spend for the initial 12-month term to cover dedicated capacity, engineering onboarding, and HSM enablement. We’ll refine once we size nodes.

Next steps I suggest:
1) 30-min technical kickoff (include your infra and security team) — propose week of Mar 22.
2) I’ll share a preliminary costing spreadsheet and a slim SOW for your procurement.
3) Vivek (cc’d) will run a compatibility checklist for the on-prem environment.

Sending a prelim costing file now — prelim-costing.xlsx attached.

—Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: prelim-costing.xlsx (Excel, 48 KB)

From: Ben Howard <ben.howard@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-12T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment expansion & renewal questions

Marissa / Monica —

Appreciate the outline. A few procurement questions to unblock internal approvals:

- Can you provide the proposed contract amendment (MSA changes) that reflect the new term and the added on-prem clusters?
- We’ll need a network/data flow diagram showing where logs and keys are stored and which data leaves our VPC (if any).
- Please include SOC 2 evidence and a short list of security controls for the on-prem agent.
- SOW: we need milestone-based invoices and an acceptance criteria section for the pilot.

Attaching our initial questionnaire — it’s short. Happy to review after your proposed SOW.

Regards,
Ben
Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics

Attachment: acme-questions.docx (DOCX, 36 KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-13T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment expansion & renewal questions (internal)

Team —

Quick internal notes after reviewing Tara/Ben’s asks and Acme’s procurement doc:

- Technical constraints: we can enable HSM via our customer-managed KMS integration; need their HSM vendor and certs.
- Capacity: recommend baseline of 4 nodes per cluster for EU pilot (gpu-equivalent sizing) and 8 nodes for US production cluster.
- Ops: propose 2-week pilot window for validation; acceptance criteria = successful KV cache warmup, <150ms p50 inference for 1k token requests, and failover test.
- Compliance: hand off SOC 2 artefacts and provide a runbook for audit. Monica to own SOW milestone language.

Sean — can you confirm if we have any current EU hardware reservations that would speed the timeline? Vivek — please prepare a short checklist for required customer infra (network ports, outbound endpoints, certs).

Attaching draft ops plan (deployment-ops-plan.md) and I’ll draft milestone language for the SOW.

—Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: deployment-ops-plan.md (TXT/MD, 6 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tara Nguyen <tara@acme-analytics.com>, Ben Howard <ben.howard@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment expansion & renewal — proposed term amendment and next steps

Tara / Ben —

Thanks again for the clear requirements. Based on the internal sizing call and ops plan, here is our proposed commercial & timeline summary to include in the renewal amendment: 

- Term: 12-month renewal starting May 1, 2026.
- Expansion: Add two Private clusters (EU on-prem pilot, US on-prem production cluster). EU cluster: 4 nodes (pilot). US cluster: 8 nodes (production).
- Security: HSM/KMS integration + SOC 2 artefact delivery. Redwood will provide an HSM integration runbook and perform a control mapping.
- SLA & Support: 99.9% SLO for private clusters, Premium Support (SLA-backed response windows), and two quarterly architecture reviews during first term.
- Commercial: Initial uplift of +42% on current committed spend for the first 12 months (covers engineering onboarding, pilot, and HSM enablement). Detailed line items in attached renewal-amendment-2026.pdf.
- Billing: milestone-based invoices aligned to pilot completion, production acceptance, and final handover.

Next actions:
1) Sign the renewal amendment (DocuSign link below).
2) Technical kickoff — propose Mar 24, 2026 (30–45 minutes). Please confirm which day works for your infra lead.
3) Monica will provide SOW milestone language and compliance packet within 3 business days.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/txn/ABC123
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0BzAcme/deployment-scope

If this looks good I’ll route the amendment through legal and procurement and send a clean SOW for signature.

—Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: renewal-amendment-2026.pdf (PDF, 72 KB)
